definitions.gloss: chestnut color; auburn; maroon; dark reddish-brown
definitions.explanation: A warm, dark reddish-brown color resembling the outer shell of a chestnut. Commonly used to describe hair color, dyes, and natural tones.

examples.japanese: {栗色|くりいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{栗色|くりいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}めた→染める：04253_someru⟧。
examples.english: She dyed her hair chestnut brown.
In autumn, the mountain trees turn a chestnut brown.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{栗|くり}→栗：04387_kuri⟧ (chestnut) + ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ (color). A traditional Japanese color name describing a warm, dark brown with reddish tones, like the shell of a Japanese chestnut.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {栗色|くりいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧: chestnut/auburn hair
- {栗色|くりいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}める→染める：04253_someru⟧: to dye chestnut brown
- {栗色|くりいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{瞳|ひとみ}→瞳：02252_hitomi⟧: chestnut-colored eyes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{茶色|ちゃいろ}→茶色：02915_chairo⟧: brown — the general term for brown
- ⟦{焦|こ}げ{茶|ちゃ}→焦げ茶：18201_kogecha⟧: dark brown — darker, without the reddish warmth
- ⟦こげ{茶色|ちゃいろ}→こげ茶色：22900_kogechairo⟧: dark brown color

CULTURAL NOTE:
One of Japan's traditional color names ({和色|わしょく}). {栗色|くりいろ} is one of the most popular hair color choices in Japan, as it is a natural-looking shade that is common in hair dye products.
